agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: Bushtank fainted only after five Razor Leaf selections into Eelektrik, four of which executed; its last interrupted attack created a free Ohmnomnom entry.
Bugatti used three Bug Bites into Sunflora before fainting to Energy Ball. Ohmnomnom then converted the forced entry into legal Fake Out and completed the matchup transition.
All six switches were direct matchup entries or forced replacements. Every voluntary entrant acted before leaving; no reversal followed a no-action entry and no consecutive switch stall occurred.
The fight used 23 decisions and 16 executed attacks. One selected Bushtank attack was interrupted by its faint, but no verified alternative dominated the reserve-preserving sacrifice.

correct_choices: Lildozer defeated Ponyta in two Bulldozes and survived at 8 HP before switching once to the Eelektrik counter.
Ohmnomnom used fresh Fake Out and Spark against Eelektrik, then later used another legal fresh Fake Out after Bugatti's productive Sunflora damage.
Birdlaw entered against Dustox only after Ohmnomnom acted, then stayed in through the terminal KO.
The authoritative terminal state verified victory with Ohmnomnom 13 HP, Croakatoa 46 HP, Lildozer 8 HP, and Birdlaw 8 HP.
agent_review.next_test: Record this reviewed win as qualification streak 3 for the unchanged opening and behavior hashes, then validate the live gate before any live input.
